notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/e48e4889e105816c244b763dc1eb82d785a016f1.png[/img]

[b][i]Hello friends! Welcome to devlog number 6! [/i][/b]

It's been a while since you've heard from me, but let me tell you that I'm still working hard on the game. What started out as a "smaller" game has now turned out to be a big horror-sci-fi-cyberpunk game! 
The average playing time is between 8 and 10 hours, depending on whether you want to uncover all the secrets. And there's a [b]lot[/b] to discover!
There is a lot to tell and as always you can read about some changes and new features below. I hope you like it!

[list]
[*] [b]The Prologue[/b]
Because the game has become very complex, I decided to implement a prologue. 
The prologue is used to better classify the story and the background. Why does Abraham end up in the Freedom Towers, what happened before the Freedom Towers? 
You can experience all of this and more in the prologue and of course play it too, because the prologue is not an animation or video, you actively play the prologue.
The prologue is an outdoor level, with a road and traffic system. There are some houses, a school, a hotel, a gas station, [b]a working cinema[/b] and much more. Of course you can explore all of them.

[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]The mobile pickup truck[/b]
In the prologue there is a pickup truck, which you can see briefly in the trailer. It is completely drivable and interactive. This makes it easier for you to overcome the longer distances in the prologue. From the cockpit view to the external view (there are 5 views), everything is included. A working car radio with selectable radio stations, 3 light modes, windshield wipers is also on board. The pickup is fully animated, which means you can open doors, use the loading area and so on. The pickup is not only used in the prologue, but also a little later in the game.

[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]The Phonesystem[/b]
In the prologue you will find old telephone booths (later in the game there are also telephones but in a different style). You can call and receive calls from these. They also serve as progress saves in the "Hard" difficulty level. In "Hard" mode you have to dial a specific number to save the game.
You can also look forward to some very scary and funny calls and conversations.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]The Collectibles[/b]
I have now implemented a collectibles system in addition to the Steam achievements. You can collect various items in the game which are then available in a collectibles screen (which you can access from the inventory). The collectibles are not just simple collectibles, but some also have a function and can give you advantages in the game. Of course there are also collectibles which unlock prototype drawings or small videos of the development of the game. You can also expect a few funny Easter eggs. In the next few days I will create a separate update on this where you can also see pictures and videos.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]A few screenshots sorted by the respective update[/b]
[b][i]The Prologue:[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/887b0f9ca91d9ec1b2f323da1d08587fe13f23fa.png[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[*]The driveable pickup truck
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/5a595973c64a5c6c8907998e31496088b30d7e09.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/cfe51161a5ba91f51180aad67b834772b3b8bd71.png[/img]

[/list]
[list]
[*]The phone system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/3aafc07f3e1c9f838152e85d5bd9fafa458d99ea.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/4b549a50536e389f00f368c6b8b715617ec972e8.png[/img]
[/list]
Finally, I would like to mention that you can look forward to regular updates from now on. 
Check back now and then and feel free to leave feedback, requests or suggestions in the discussion thread. 
I will read this regularly and look forward to your numerous comments. 
I would also like to mention that you should take a look at our publisher Bonus Stage. 
There you will not only find numerous high-quality games, but also a very nice, funny and, above all, respectful community. 

Welcome to the family!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/91822d7b6c052a78c13d652bdfa9420427a4a9e4.png[/img]

Hey friends and welcome to [i][b]Devlog No.5![/b][/i]
This time it's been a little longer since the devlog appeared and there are a few reasons for that. 
I've been working alone on STCB for quite some time as my son (our programmer at AsylumLabs) is going through a career change. 
So it's going a bit slower, but I think the important thing is that it's going forward. 
Nevertheless, my son will continue to be responsible for bug fixing, just not in the ongoing development process.

So maybe bear with me if things don't go as quickly as expected.
But now to the devlog, here below you can see the new features as always, hope you like it.
[list]
[*][i][b]The back rooms (wait, back rooms, really?):[/b][/i]
Yes indeed! It's just that we don't call them back rooms, we call them "anomalies". 
Why "anomalies"? The back rooms as you all probably know them are creepy here and there, but does something like that fit into a game like STCB? I think NO! 
The "Smiley Face" from the Back Rooms alone doesn't make me shudder, but rather makes me laugh. 
This is not a criticism of the Back Rooms, just my opinion on it. 
Also not to sound condescending or snooty, no, I've just watched far too many horror movies and science fiction movies for things like The Back Rooms to scare me. After all, I'll be 44 in July, and with that age, as a film fan, you've already watched quite a few works. 
So why not further develop the back rooms and make them suitable for STCB? 
That's exactly what I did! The creatures in our "Anomalies" are very frightening, ugly, and sometimes grotesque to disturbing. 
I think this is spot on for STCB. 
The rooms and their contents are also different from those in the back rooms. 
Only the basic principle is the same, isn't it?.....  Maybe!
[*][i][b]Gas Mask:[/b][/i]  From now on there is a gas mask in the game. It is used in some areas and is also mandatory in the "Anomaly" areas.
[*][i][b]Currency:[/b][/i]  From now on there is a currency in the game. 
It doesn't have a name yet, but we'll let you vote on it soon. You can find this "currency" in the game (it is not possible to buy this currency with real money and thus gain advantages). 
The currency will be found in chests, drawers, apartments, and so on. 
With this, you can then enter shops in the game and buy weapons and equipment. 
There will also be something like a vending machine here and there where you can buy food, drinks, or other useful things. 
With the currency, we also wanted to bring a bit of an RPG aspect into the game.
[*][i][b]Portals:[/b][/i] At various points in the game you can open portals and move through them. 
You can look into the portals before you go through them, so you have a small impression of where each portal leads. 
Some portals lead back to the point you went through, but others close immediately after you use them. 
So you have to think carefully beforehand whether you want to use the portal now or later.
[/list]
[i][b]Additions to Devlog 5:[/b][/i]  Of course, a lot more has been added, since I still have to prepare screenshots and videos for this, I will summarize everything in Devlog 5.5 (later this week). All in all, I hope you enjoyed the devlog and the new features, and say see you later

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/33c6a4441479114943c2f017c9840b5782371dc8.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hello friends and welcome to Devlog 4![/b][/h1]
This time it took a long time until the next devlog. 
But it was worth the wait as today we have released the Steam Scream Fest update! 
Download the demo and try it for yourself. 

We completely redesigned the entire first stage, bigger, badder and more menacing! 
Additionally we added the second floor, this is also playable in the demo. 
The update is now [b]live[/b]! Below are some of the key things we've changed and added. 

[b]Have fun with the demo![/b]

[list]
[*]Craftable lockpicks
[*]Way better performance
[*]4 puzzles added
[*]Usable elevator
[*]Added a lot of interactive things to increase the depth of the game
[*]Full controller support
[*]Added new weapons
[*]Steam achievements added
[*]Brightness panel added
[*]Added a completely new floor (Floor 2), which is also available in the demo!
[*]Spiders removed
[*]Voice acting removed! We removed the robotic voices and replaced them with text, until we find good voice actors
[*]Increased the readability of the subtitles
[*]And many more things that you can experience, collect or use. Even an old frying pan can be used as a weapon.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/ae2ed329aeb87abcbb17ffa5a3bfcf2a9922e57c.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hello friends and welcome to Devlog 3![/b][/h1]

[list]
[*][b]FPS limit setting in options[/b]: It is now possible to determine and / or limit the framerate in the options
[*][b]Anisotropic filtering has now also been added to the options. Level x2 - x16 selectable[/b]
[*][b]Inventory drag and drop and move[/b]: Now fully tested and implemented
[*][b]Brightness options added[/b]: In the options (and also if you start a new game) a brightness settings screen will appear. 
   Pretty much the same as in other games. 
   You see three images and can adjust the brightness so that a certain image is difficult to see in order to choose the optimal brightness.
[*][b]Full controller support[/b]: From now on it is possible to use a gamepad (Playstation® or Xbox). 
   4g3v has adapted everything for this so that there are no longer any problems playing STCB with a gamepad.
[*][b]AI settings[/b]: NPCs can now behave differently.
   These include being friendly, aggressive, I don't care how behaved, neutral and alert. 
    In addition, the NPCs have become much smarter and no longer act like Frankenstein or like me 😂
[*][b]New feature "Syringe" added[/b]: Various syringes can now be found in the game. 
   They differ in the color of the drug that is injected and thus in the effect. For example, red returns health. We have a little video for you below.
[*][b]And also, as some of you have requested, there's now an outline on items[/b]:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/9e29a821fb726b4b5c825f11c6cda53c570a32d2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/fe23a0b80f36d5dfbfcbc1f968fae0ca11073b54.png[/img][/url]
[/list]
[h3][b]And last but not least, now there is also an "outside level"![/b][/h3]
You read that correctly, there will be "something" in the game that will teleport you to another "world". 
Unfortunately we can't give you any more information about why and how we did it, otherwise we would reveal too much. 
But what we can tell you is that it will be AWESOME!

[previewyoutube=1UDlzM4yeww;full][/previewyoutube]

- Brightness options added: In the options (and also if you start a new game) a brightness settings screen will appear.
- Full controller support: From now on it is possible to use a gamepad (Playstation® or Xbox).
- AI settings: NPCs can now behave differently.
- New feature "Syringe" added: Various syringes can now be found in the game.

And last but not least, now there is also an "outside level"!

notes.title: Devlog #2.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42254159/1d11786fd97ace5a0bd268724fe97e6ef9777ee3.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hello friends and welcome to Devlog 2.5![/b][/h1]

[i]This time we have prepared some new things for you.
The first would be the in-game textures.
We have completely revised these, they now appear more natural and have a higher resolution.
You can see that in the before and after pictures. Despite the better-looking textures,
we didn't see any performance drops in the framerate,
on the contrary, the game now seems 1000 kilograms lighter and smoother.
We have also finally been able to part with the unrealistic blood.
We managed to add real volumetric blood to the game!
This is expressed in terms of the better looks, as well as the much more realistic behavior of the blood.
Blood can now splatter on the wall, floor, and also stains the victim.
For this we recommend the short video in this post.
We have also worked on the settings.
We added anisotropic filtering in the options where you can choose between 0-16 levels.
Likewise, there is now a frame limiter function in the options.
Here you can choose between 0 (no limit) and 400 frames.
Furthermore, there is now a map computer in the game that shows you the floor you are currently on (top view / 3D view and also freely rotatable).
Interesting destinations, POI and other important and relevant things are also displayed in the map computer.
Well then, we hope you like the new things and look forward to your feedback![/i]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ePZR9wr.gif[/img]
[b]Hello friends and welcome to the first official devlog! 
From now on we will inform you every week (every Monday) about the current progress of Sometimes They Come Back. 
We can always discuss news, fixes and new content here after the new devlog. 
Of course we've been working on the game continuously for the last week. 
All of your suggestions have been incorporated.
The new update is on its way already!
So then, here comes devlog number 1, week 25:[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] HelixOS event system bug [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Sami)
   Here there was the problem that the login screen could no longer be unlocked.
[*] Some items wasn't dropable [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Sami)
  On drop item, the item just vanished but didn't drop
[*] Fuse drop bug [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Sami)
   Fuses dropped on the floor could be duplicated indefinitely. 
[*] Toilet animation bug [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Merlin)
   Kinda a funny bug, if you had an item equipped such as the flashlight and you used the toilet, a second arm appears waving around with the same item.
[*] Corpse Colliders [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Paul)
   Not really a bug, but when you looted the corpses you couldn't start the loot process if you aimed at the head.
[*] Collider bug in the gaming room [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Jo aka Joseph)
   It was possible to just walk through the wall right next to the locked door
[/list]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory drag and drop
  Now you can just drag items out of inventory to drop them. You can easily drag and drop items in inventory, and it is now possible to drag and drop items from 
  inventory to storage boxes. So you don't have to keep accessing the context menu and choosing "Drop" or "Store".[/list]

[*] Fuse drop bug [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Sami)
[*] Toilet animation bug [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Merlin)
[*] Collider bug in the gaming room [b]FIXED[/b] (Special thanks to Jo aka Joseph)
